earned.test_owner_login_returns_access_token: the body reads the owner_account row and asserts the stored password_hash is not the seeded literal, and that the seeded sign-in returns a token
earned.test_world_manifest_lists_only_published: the body asserts every published project reaches the world manifest and no draft does
earned.test_text_route_lists_published_projects: the body reads the text route as a visitor with no session
earned.test_health_endpoint_reports_ready: the request reaches the app at APP_PUBLIC_URL through the mapped port, under the api prefix, after the agent session ended and from outside the app's own process, so answering at all is the observation
earned.test_seeded_projects_row_state_matches_m: the body reads the seeded rows through the declared PostgreSQL service by their pinned table name and asserts exactly one row per seeded slug, which is what a non-idempotent seed breaks
earned.test_publish_persists_row_and_stored_obj: the body asserts the image row holds the object key while the bytes live in the bucket
earned.test_poster_upload_lands_in_bucket_at_sc: the body asserts the bytes exist in the declared MinIO bucket at the key derived from their hash, which is what rules out a filesystem or database copy
earned.test_published_poster_file_streams_to_an: the body asserts the uploaded poster carries the owner-written alternative text before publishing it
earned.test_whisper_wall_never_exceeds_thirty_r: the body reads the public whisper endpoint and asserts the returned JSON array holds at most the stated cap
earned.test_draft_direct_address_is_denied_to_a: the body requests the draft slug at its own API address and at its own page address and asserts both answer as though the project does not exist
earned.test_draft_is_absent_from_the_text_route: the body asserts the draft slug appears in neither the public list nor the text route
earned.test_anonymous_cannot_create_project_den: the body calls the studio write endpoint directly with no session and asserts the row was never written
earned.test_anonymous_cannot_publish_project_de: the body calls the publish endpoint directly with no session, so it observes the refusal at the write path rather than a hidden control
earned.test_login_with_wrong_password_is_reject: the body asserts the refusal is a client error rather than a server error and returns no token
earned.test_publish_onto_occupied_coordinates_i: the body publishes through the endpoint itself, then asserts the refusal names the occupying slug, that the refused project keeps an empty published timestamp, and that the project already in place is untouched
earned.test_concurrent_publish_at_one_point_yie: the body counts the published rows at one coordinate triple after two simultaneous publishes
earned.test_empty_leaderboard_returns_empty_arr: the body reads the daily board endpoint and asserts its shape with no lap recorded today
earned.test_self_adjacent_project_is_refused: the body sets a project's previous neighbour to its own slug and asserts the write is refused
earned.test_root_document_is_server_rendered_wi: the body asserts the served document carries an input-filter class naming the consumer that owns the keyboard
earned.test_credentials_note_and_reserved_direc: the body opens the credentials note at the app root and asserts both reserved directories exist beside it
earned.test_public_surfaces_need_no_sign_in: the body reads every public endpoint and both public pages with no session
